effect_description_eng: [On Play] Place 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait from your trash under 1 of your Tamers. If you have a Digimon with [Dorulumon] in its name or with [Dorulumon] in its digivolution cards, place up to 2 Digimon cards with the [Xros Heart] trait from your trash under 1 of your Tamers instead.
